responsibility: Declares the public interface to GCC’s debug-counter subsystem. It turns dbgcnt.def into the debug_counter enumeration and exposes the APIs used by optimization code and option handling to test counters, query current counts, parse -fdbg-cnt settings, and print configured counters, making it the header-level contract for transformation gating rather than the storage or parsing implementation itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface layer of the dbgcnt group: it includes dbgcnt.def to form the debug_counter enum and declares the callable APIs. Unlike dbgcnt.def, which is just the master counter-name list, and dbgcnt.cc, which implements parsing, storage, and counter checks, this header is the contract clients include.
